protocol.geometry: Same analytic sinusoidal scene and camera/depth/colour as temporal diagnosis. At frame 64 camera translates (192/focal,96/focal), focal=90/tan(pi/6): FG displacement (-96,+48), BG (-24,+12) render pixels. World textures stay fixed; foreground keeps its local texture. All geometry remains in the measured viewport through frame 127.
protocol.motion: Unjittered previousUV-currentUV: ordinary FG (-.375/320,-.25/180), BG zero. Cut FG ((96-.375)/320,(-48-.25)/180), BG (24/320,-12/180). Colour/depth/motion/exposure/jitter/timing identical across post-cut arms, including fresh frame 64. Jitter uses absolute phase; does not restart.
protocol.histories: reset and no-reset build frames 0..63 in one context, then continue through 127. reset requests reset at 0 and 64; no-reset at 0 only. fresh starts one new context at absolute frame 64, resets once there, and continues through 127. All resources retained until fences and context destruction; no lifetime-policy changes.
protocol.evaluation: Full byte input audit and finite/sentinel/fence/device/debug checks precede analysis. Point reference for interiors, exact area for edge, known true-flow foreground temporal residual from 65 onwards. Ghost region is pre-cut foreground interior intersected with current background interior; it measures the old screen footprint, not a universal physical disocclusion age. Per-frame metrics and paired RGBA maximum/reset-fresh/no-reset-fresh differences retained. Synthetic old-history contamination at 0/25/50/100% must discriminate and increase with severity before GPU dispatch.
protocol.selection_rule: Exploration establishes no native quality acceptance. Select five fresh-context limits as 1.25 times the maximum window MAE plus .000001. Reset/fresh RGBA difference must remain <=.000001 on all 64 post-cut frames. No-reset/fresh interior MAE averaged over first eight frames must exceed reset/fresh by >=.0001, demonstrating retained-history sensitivity without requiring no-reset to lose every analytic metric. Selection fails if these fixed predictions are unsupported. Freeze selected limits before three independent confirmations.
protocol.limits: 128 frames per history arm plus 64 fresh frames = 320 GPU frames per block; 25 input-only frames. Native child watchdog 360s. Correlated frames, one GPU/provider/driver; reset equality alone is not improved perceptual quality. No universal quality, lifetime or hardware support claim. Ordinary/release gates remain unchanged.

scope: Synthetic camera cut; correlated frames on one equipment configuration; no universal reset/perceptual guarantee

criteria.rule: 1.25 times largest fresh-context window MAE plus .000001; fixed RGBA reset/fresh tolerance .000001 from the cut onwards; first-eight-frame no-reset/fresh interior MAE must exceed reset/fresh by .0001
criteria.claim: Reset clears pre-cut history to the fresh-context result. No prediction that no-reset loses every analytic quality metric.

known_defect_validation.scope: Known analytic missing-object, constant-image, blur, flicker and 25% old-history defects; not AMD outputs

criteria_controls.scope: Known analytic missing-object, constant-image, blur, flicker and 25% old-history defects; not AMD outputs
